metadata.description: Haiku subagents, guard hooks, evaluation pipeline and a safe verification runner for GxP-regulated engineering teams.

plugins.name: haiku-delegation
plugins.description: Read-only Haiku 5.5 subagents with effort tiers and a delegation policy.

plugins.name: agent-guards
plugins.description: Secret redaction, .env protection, bulk-read redirect, monitor guard, read-only git.

plugins.name: agent-eval
plugins.description: Usage log, deterministic checks, annotator agent, operator judge and review CLIs.

plugins.name: verification-runner
plugins.description: Test/lint/build runner (Claude Code permissions decide the commands) with safe-rm quarantine.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Focused Haiku 5.5 reviewers (spec, defect, architecture, security, project rules, history, simplicity) with an independent finding validator and a /code-review:review skill.

plugins.name: proof-lab
plugins.description: Prove a feature works in the real app: a spec run, a signed receipt, and a guard on the signing key. Uses a proof-lab checkout pinned by commit.
